text:
Sam: Quick heads-up — finished the RoPE scaling sweep across Llama/Mistral/Mixtral/Qwen (linear/NTK/YARN). Found a sharp perplexity cliff on Qwen with the YARN variant around ~32k tokens. Putting notes/logs below.

Devon: can you paste the numbers? :eyes:

Sam: summary:
```
model    variant  ctx_tokens  tokens/sec  ppl
Qwen     YARN     32768       42          18.4 -> 67.2 (cliff)
Mixtral  NTK      32768       48          16.9
Llama    linear   32768       50          17.2
```
The cliff correlates with KV-cache evictions and a kernel fallback event.

Julia: hmm, KV window eviction looks like it's triggered sooner for Qwen-YARN. Could be head/kdim mismatch causing extra copies.

Mike: I saw a kernel routing log around the cliff:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z kernel_router: selecting kernel=mixed_attention_fast fallback=soft_attn_v2 reason="kv_mismatch"
```
When fallback happens throughput drops and PPL explodes.

Nora: suggestion: tighten batching heuristic for Qwen-YARN (max_batch_seq from 512 -> 256) and pin kernel_policy to prefer stable_attention_v1 while we triage. Rollout to dedicated pool only.

Sam: agreed. Also think we should disable prefix-KV eviction for longctx on Qwen until we confirm. I posted the profiling command below — run on a dedicated node with perf enabled:
```
./run_profile.sh --model qwen --variant yarn --ctx 35000 --trace kernel,kv,mem --out /tmp/qwen-yarn-flame.svg
```

ci-bot: perf-bench/job/578 completed: summary attached (url: https://ci.internal/bench/578)

Devon: if someone runs that, drop the flamegraph link here. I'll open a narrow A/B that toggles batching + kernel pin and collect eval prompt set.

Julia: starting a 24h sweep on dev-dedicated-3, cc @eng-sre. Will also log KV window sizes and head dim reshapes.

Sam: creating tracking issue and assigning to Mike/Nora for rollback plan if regression persists. Issue: INF-4823

Mike: noted. I'll prepare the kernel pin PR and the batching tweak. :thumbsup:

Nora: will monitor costs — reducing batch_seq increases per-token latency but should keep quality stable. We'll test cost delta in the A/B.

Sam: thanks all. If anyone sees the cliff on other models or variants, ping here. End of thread.
